purpose: Committed decisions for tools/compat-matrix/surface-coverage.mjs. The gate derives the pinned routes (docs/api-inventory.md), the Go registrations (internal/server/*.go) and the frontend surfaces (upstream/public/**/*.js + the startup and extension observations) and requires EVERY surface to be classified as implemented / intentionally-passthrough / not-applicable / unsupported-with-reason. An entry here is the human decision a derived surface cannot make for itself. Every entry must still name a live surface: the gate fails a stale one, so an exception cannot outlive the behaviour it excused.

goExceptions.reason: AGENTS.md boundary 3, DECIDED 2026-10-29: the pinned route stores a Jimp output file, and GoTavern serves the OBSERVABLE contract from a pure-Go codec -- status, MIME/original-name behaviour, decodability, exact dimensions, the pinned 512x768 want_resize box, cover-not-stretch geometry, PNG output whatever was uploaded, and cache behaviour.
